posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: Feel free to audtion, that way at least the crew has a decent idea of what you can do with your voice. Ideally, Kyote, we’d love to expand the radio play. My original scripts are very large in focus, but as it stands we’re kind of a small, ragtag group, and for now it’s best to start with a smaller focus. Voice actors often play multiple roles in a show or movie, and so just because you get cast as one thing early on, doesn’t mean you can’t get another part once it becomes available.
